actions.title: Send tracking immediately when orders process
actions.why: Buyers who see tracking early are less likely to file cases before packages arrive.

actions.title: Use a fresh tracking number per order, never reuse
actions.why: Each order needs its own tracking number so PayPal can verify which payment it covers.

actions.title: Reply quickly to cases with photos of shipment
actions.why: Fast responses with proof of shipping can resolve disputes filed prematurely before delivery.
